## Facts (3):
- [convention] Notifier email templates (id: 01a10715-d857-7703-96a6-6a0dbbf57255; source: shared/human)
  Email templates live in services/notifier/templates/ as `<event>.mjml` and are compiled at build time. Every template needs a plain-text twin `<event>.txt` with the same variables, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML. Template variables are snake_case.
- [hazard] Email provider: sandbox behaviour and limits (id: 01a10716-30f7-7cc1-9234-fd3ca928748c; source: shared/human)
  The notifier sends through the email provider's HTTP API (provider.send). Production credentials exist only in the deployed function's environment. For development there is a separate sandbox account whose key is in the dev secrets store; export it as MAIL_API_KEY. The sandbox has the same API and response shapes, but it is rate-limited to 2 messages per second and capped at 500 messages a day for the whole team, so do not loop over large fixtures. Bounces and complaints are simulated with magic addresses from the provider's docs. Important: the sandbox silently drops (answers 202, never delivers) every message whose recipient is not on the `@sink.acme.test` domain, so a test that asserts delivery must send to an address such as `receipts@sink.acme.test` and read it back from the sink inbox API.
- [context] Who owns the notifier (current) (id: 01a10716-64c0-7b32-aacb-2f3fbfbd1454; source: shared/human)
  As of 2026-09-01 the notifier belongs to the Growth team (Dana Okafor moved to Platform). Template and copy changes are signed off in #growth-eng; any Growth engineer can approve.","hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit"}}

The Growth team owns the notifier, so copy changes are signed off by them. Post the change in **#growth-eng**. Any Growth engineer can approve it, and you don't need a specific named person.

This comes from a project memory dated 2026-09-01. Ownership moved from Dana Okafor, who is now on Platform, to Growth. Nothing in the repo contradicts it, but nothing confirms it either. There's no CODEOWNERS file, and the READMEs don't mention ownership. If it matters, confirm in #growth-eng.

Two things to keep in mind when you edit the email:
- **Plain-text twin:** templates live in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`. Each one needs a matching `<event>.txt` with the same variables, so update both. Variables are snake_case.
- **Testing delivery:** the sandbox email provider silently drops anything not addressed to `@sink.acme.test`. Use an address like `receipts@sink.acme.test` and read it back from the sink inbox API. The sandbox is also capped at 2 messages per second and 500 per day for the whole team.
